from collections import deque, Counter
def analyze(dname):
    gi=G[dname+' input']; go=G[dname+' output']
    h=len(gi); w=len(gi[0])
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==2]
    goals=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==3]
    d={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=go[r][c]}
    added=d-set(seeds)-set(goals)
    bg=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    q=deque(seeds); dist={s:0 for s in seeds}; par={}
    target=set(goals)
    while q:
        cell=q.popleft()
        if cell in target: break
        r,c=cell
        for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            n=(r+dr,c+dc)
            if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and n not in dist and (gi[n[0]][n[1]]==bg or n in target):
                dist[n]=dist[cell]+1; par[n]=cell; q.append(n)
    best=min(target,key=lambda t:dist.get(t,999))
    p=[]
    while True:
        p.append(best); breakpoint=p
        if best in seeds: break
        best=par[best]
    sp=list(reversed(p))  # shortest path cells from seed to goal set
    print(dname,'added len',len(added),'BFSshortest len',len(sp))
    print('  sp==added?',set(sp)==set(added), sorted(sp)[:6], sorted(added)[:6])
for d in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']: analyze(d)

from collections import Counter
def occmap(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return bg,{(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]!=bg and gi[r][c]!=2 and gi[r][c]!=3}
for d in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[d+' input']
    bg,obst=occmap(gi)
    seeds=[(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]==2]
    goals=[(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]==3]
    added={(r,c) for r in range(len(gi)) for c in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[r][c]!=G[d+' output'][r][c]}-set(seeds)-set(goals)
    # min clearance of chosen path cells to obstacles
    def clear8(cell):
        r,c=cell; d=min(abs(r-o[0])+abs(c-o[1]) for o in obst)
        return d
    m=min(clear8(x) for x in added); M=max(clear8(x) for x in added)
    print(d,'added min/max clearance',m,M,'count',len(added),'seeds',seeds,'goals',goals)

from collections import deque
def analyze(k):
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    wall=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]   # dominant
    add={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==3 and gi[r][c]!=3}
    seed={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==2}
    goal={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==3}
    # endpoints (segment extremities)
    def ends(s):
        s=set(s); out=[]
        if len({r for r,c in s})==1: out=[(min(c for r,c in s),max(c for r,c in s))]
        elif len({c for r,c in s})==1: out=[(min(r for r,c in s),max(r for r,c in s))]
        return out
    seends=ends(seed); gend=ends(goal)
    return gi,h,w,wall,add,seends,gend
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    gi,h,w,wall,add,seends,gend=analyze(k)

    rs=[r for r,c in add]; cs=[c for r,c in add]
    print('   rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs))

    print('==',k,'wall',wall)

    print(' added',sorted(add))

from collections import deque
def bsp(k):
    gi=G[k+' input'];go=G[k+' output'];h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    wall=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    add={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if go[r][c]==3 and gi[r][c]!=3}
    seen=set(seed);par={};dq=deque(seed)
    end=None
    while dq:
        r,c=dq.popleft()

    while cur not in seed:
        p.append(cur);cur=par[cur]
    p.reverse();p.remove(end)
    return sorted(set(p)),wall,add

import json
def solve(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row).most_common()
    ob=cnt[1][0];bgc=cnt[0][0]
    seed=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==2]
    goal=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==3]
    o=set(seed+goal)
    # BFS over background cells (bgc and ob both? walls are only 5th color... actually obstacle = any non-bg; path must use bg cells)
    passable=lambda v: v==bgc
    dist={}
    dq=deque();seen=set()
    for s_ in seed:
        seen.add(s_)
        for d_ in goal:
            pass
    # multi-source from seed, target = any goal cell
    start=seed[0]
    seen.add(start);par={};dq=deque([start]);goalcell=None
    while dq and not goalcell:
        y=dq.popleft()
        if y in set(goal)-set(seed): goalcell=y;break
        for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr,nc=y[0]+dr,y[1]+dc
            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and passable(gi[nr][nc]):

    path=[];cur=goalcell
    while cur not in seed:
        path.append(cur);cur=par[cur]
    add=path-[s for s in seed]
    go=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for r,c in add: go[r][c]=3
    return go,add,len(path)

def solve2(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])

    T={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r][c]==3}
    def info(cells):
        rs={r for r,_ in cells};cs={c for _,c in cells}
        horz=len(rs)==1
        if horz: return ('H',next(iter(rs)),min(cs),max(cs))
        return ('V',min(cs),(min(rs),max(rs)))
    si,sti=info(S),info(T)
    sr=sc=si[1]; s0,s1=si[2],si[3]
    tr,tc=sti[1],(sti[2],sti[3])
    res=set()
    # stage 1: extend seed along own axis toward goal until column/row aligned with goal's other extent... use earlier rule: grow to the end of goal span on this axis then perpendicular
    for dr,dc in [(0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)]:
        pass
    # growth direction along own axis: towards goal projection on that axis; grow one step at a time while target not reached and cell clear
    # first pick axis
    vert = si[0]=='V'
    # project goal onto seed's axis coords
    p = (tr, tc[0]) if vert else (sr, sc)
    # choose sign along seed axis to approach
    import math
    if vert:
        axis='col'; lo,hi=s0,s1
        gcol_lo,gcol_hi=tc
        if sc>gcol_hi: dc=-1; go_col=gcol_lo
        elif sc<gcol_lo: dc=1; go_col=gcol_hi
        else: go_col=dc*0+sc
        dcol=go_col-s0 if False else (gcol_hi if gcol_hi>s0 else gcol_lo)-s0 if False else None
        drow=(tr-sr)
        grow_len=max(abs(go_col-sc),abs(tr-sr))
        r,c=p[:1]*0+(sr,sc); path=[]
        n=go_col-sc
        for _ in range(n):
            nc=c+drow if False else c+ (0 if n>0 else (tr-sr))
        # simpler: extend along axis to goal's near edge coordinate, i.e. stop when reaching min(coord of goal) if moving toward it
        if n>0: n=min(tc) else: n=max(tc)
        for _ in range(n):
            c+=drow if False else 0; path.append((r,c))
        res|set(path)
    return res

def solve(gi,dc=1):
    hi=len(gi); wi=len(gi[0]); bg=Counter(v for r in gi for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

    for r in range(hi):

            if out[r][c]!=bg:
                out[r][(c+dc)%wi]=out[r][c]
    return out
